label: Starlight Memory MCP Server
description: The sovereign long-term memory server for Starlight swarms, providing semantic recall, vault reading, reflection retrieval, and episodic indexing.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Recall high-relevance memories and historical context for a prompt or query.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search memory nodes using hybrid semantic and keyword search.

tools.name: memory_remember
tools.description: Store a new attested fact or insight into the episodic memory graph.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Prune or supersede a memory node.

tools.name: vault_read
tools.description: Read a note from the sovereign Second Brain vault.

tools.name: vault_list
tools.description: List notes in a vault subdirectory.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Get telemetry and node count statistics for the memory engine.

label: Starlight V0 MCP Server
description: Interface for generating, branding, iterating, and pulling production-grade V0 UI components directly into Starlight repositories.

tools.name: v0_setup_check
tools.description: Verify V0 API connectivity and design token registry.

tools.name: v0_generate
tools.description: Generate a new UI component from a structured design prompt.

tools.name: v0_generate_branded
tools.description: Generate a UI component strictly locked to Starlight/Arcanea design tokens.

tools.name: v0_iterate
tools.description: Refine an existing V0 chat component based on review critique.

tools.name: v0_pull_code
tools.description: Download generated TSX/CSS code into the target repository component tree.

label: Context7 MCP Server
description: Universal live retrieval MCP for frontier framework documentation, library APIs, and latest release specs without prompt bloat.

tools.name: context7_search
tools.description: Query official live documentation for any framework or library (Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind v4, etc.).

label: CDP Multiplexer Browser Hub MCP
description: Centralized Chrome DevTools Protocol multiplexer (:9223) that routes all agent web automation through an observable shared hub.

tools.name: browser_connect
tools.description: Acquire an isolated CDP browser context session from the multiplexer hub.

label: Suno Music Generation MCP Server
description: Automates Suno v4.5 audio generation, prompt compilation, stem extraction, and catalog ingestion for Starlight audio engines.

tools.name: suno_generate_track
tools.description: Generate high-fidelity audio tracks with genre tags, BPM, and structured lyrics.
